notes.title: Patch Notes And Apologies - 1.0.18
notes.content:
We are very sorry for the various issues we have received in the two days!
There are many problems related to numerical values and AI, which have had a negative impact on everyone's experience. I am very ashamed and we are revising and adjusting now.

This update mainly includes:
1. Reduced the difficulty of Chapter 1
2. Adjusted the problem that some units were too powerful
3. The initial brain limit has been increased to unlock the blood limit earlier, making it easier to upgrade.
4. Added the ability to view details of zombies in battle.
5. Added loading interface tips
6. Added prompts for some level room areas during pause.
7. Optimized the use of building-biochemical reaction wells
8. Optimized the attack status of long-range and melee units
9. Optimized the shooting accuracy of hedgehog zombies
10. Adjusted some text
11. Adjusted the damage and position of some enemy units
12. Adjusted the tutorial on placing zombies in Rainy Night Prison
13. Adjusted the objectives of the village war level
14. Fixed the problem that the turmoil cabin in the mall can be operated
15. Fixed the problem that zombies can be placed in the gravedigger room
16. The zombie dog unit in the Rainy Night Prison has been removed. Now there will be no zombies that are attracted to the dog and get stuck together.

More adjustments are in progress, thank you for your support

notes.title: Welcome to the "Zombie Party"!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2574480/

Welcome to the "Zombie Party"!
The demo version will participate in [b]Steam's "October New Festival"[/b], and you can experience the "zombie party" demo for [b]7~14 days[/b] (exact number of days not yet determined).

This is a world where people with abilities exist, and some of them form the [Five-person Council], which holds absolute power and right to speak. And some of the other ability users were sent into the abyss by the former.
You will play the role of a person with the ability to summon zombies. After escaping from the laboratory, you will use your ability to destroy the powerful order built by the government and the [Five-member Council] on this land.

The demo will include:
[list]
[*] 10 main line levels
[*] 8 kinds of summonable zombies, don't forget to feed their brains
[*] 5 skills
[*] 1 boss riding a motorcycle passing by in a high profile
[/list]
If you encounter a bug during the game, or would like to make comments or suggestions, you are welcome to use the "feedback" function (using the shortcut key F8 in the game) to communicate with us.

Don't forget[b] add the "Zombie Party" to your wish list[/b], thank you so much and have fun!
